> Co-authors: @IceShip423 @stellaxcpeng @cen121212 @WayneLuo-HW @ranjiewen

## Motivation

GLM-5.3-Flash is a Z.ai hybrid-attention MoE VLM that interleaves MLA + DSA
(DeepSeek Sparse Attention) with linear attention and ships a built-in MTP head
for NEXTN speculative decoding. This PR ports the Ascend NPU adaptation
(Atlas A3/A5, developed on an internal fork, commits 1c76e6a01d..47594f8e1)
onto current upstream main (8854857a99), so the model can be served with SGLang
on Ascend clusters with PD disaggregation and speculative decoding.

## Modifications

- DSA attention backend and indexer kernels on NPU
  (`hardware_backend/npu/attention/ascend_dsa_backend.py`,
  `layers/attention/dsa/kpool_index_npu.py`, `kpool_bf16_index.py`,
  `kpool_lightning_indexer.py`, `kpool_decode_prepare_indexer.py`,
  `expand_pool_topk_and_append_tail_batched_npu.py`): Ascend DSA backend,
  lightning indexer, bf16/decompress kpool index kernels, decode-prepare
  indexer, and batched topk-pool tail expansion.
- Compress-tail state in the NPU MLA pool
  (`hardware_backend/npu/memory_pool_npu.py`): per-request DSA compress-tail
  k/score rings in `NPUMLATokenToKVPool`, with global indexer layer ids exposed
  for transfer pairing.
- PD disaggregation for hybrid DSA
  (`disaggregation/utils.py`, `disaggregation/ascend/conn.py`,
  `disaggregation/mooncake/conn.py`): target+draft DSA tail registration and
  merge, PP window slicing of tail pointers, and live-token remap between rings
  with different speculative slot counts.
- NEXTN speculative decoding on NPU
  (`kernels/ops/mamba/causal_conv1d_target_verify.py`,
  `kernels/ops/speculative/spec_tree_npu.py`,
  `kernels/ops/speculative/cache_locs.py`,
  `speculative/draft_utils.py`, `speculative/eagle_utils.py`): target-verify
  conv1d update kernel, NPU spec-tree kernels, and draft runner integration.
- MoE and quantization
  (`hardware_backend/npu/quantization/moe_methods.py`,
  `layers/quantization/modelslim/modelslim.py`, `layers/quantization/fp8.py`,
  `layers/moe/token_dispatcher/deepep.py`): ModelSlim W8A8 serving paths, A5
  (arch 3510) detection, and DeepEP token-dispatcher hooks.
- Multimodal preprocessing on NPU
  (`hardware_backend/npu/modules/glm5_next_processor.py`,
  `hardware_backend/npu/modules/glmga_processor.py`,
  `multimodal/processors/base_processor.py`).
- Portability fixes onto the new upstream layer-boundary architecture
  (`model_executor/model_runner.py`, `managers/scheduler_pp_mixin.py`,
  `kernels/ops/attention/fla/chunk_delta_h.py`): PP proxy scattered-boundary
  queries re-expressed on the new `layer_boundary` declarations (the legacy
  `layers.communicator` module is gone), legacy cfg-flag migration, and a
  triton-ascend workaround for the missing `constexpr and runtime-condition`
  short-circuit in `chunk_delta_h`.
- Tests (`layers/attention/dsa/test/*_npu.py`,
  `test/ascend/test_ascend_memory_registration.py`): unit tests for the kpool
  NPU kernels (assemble-softmax-write-cache, decode compress-and-write-cache,
  MTP flow, tail scatter updates, lightning indexer accuracy).

## Accuracy Tests

Validated end-to-end on a two-node Atlas A3 cluster (32 dies) with
GLM-5.3-Flash-W8A8 (ModelSlim quantized weights):

- Prefill/decode disaggregation with the Ascend transfer backend
  (prefill tp=16, decode tp=16 dp=16, DeepEP normal mode).
- NEXTN speculative decoding on the decode side
  (`--speculative-algorithm NEXTN --speculative-num-steps 3
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`), including
  DSA compress-tail state transfer for target + draft layers.
- Server bring-up, generation correctness, and DSA state/kv transfer pairing
  across heterogeneous attention-TP topologies.

A5 (950PR/DT, arch 3510) code paths are included but not yet hardware-validated;
they are guarded by device/arch detection (`is_npu_a5` / `is_npu_arch35`) and
fall back to the A3 path.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

To be attached. (E2E throughput/latency numbers on the A3 PD setup will be
added before merge; no CUDA-path performance is affected by this change.)

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (NPU-only tests; they require Ascend hardware and are skipped on CUDA runners.)
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Notes for Reviewers

- Depends on `sgl-kernel-npu` for a few fused FLA/MoE ops (e.g.
  `fused_sigmoid_gating_recurrent_decode_optimized`); the vendored Triton
  kernels in this PR cover the rest.

+    def _query_lens_device(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> torch.Tensor:

+                    f"got {forward_batch.extend_seq_lens.shape[0]} lengths for "
+                    f"batch_size={batch_size}."

+            (batch_size,),

+    def _query_layout_sizes(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """Return packed-token count and maximum query length from host metadata."""
+        mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        batch_size = forward_batch.batch_size
+

+            query_len = int(self.speculative_num_draft_tokens)

+        # Expand it per query at the indexer's paged entry point for MTP reads;

+            forward_batch.req_pool_indices[: forward_batch.batch_size],

+            (page_table_1[:, :: self.page_size] // self.page_size)

+                dtype=torch.int32,

+                real_page_table_computed

+            mode.is_extend() or mode.is_target_verify() or mode.is_draft_extend_v2()

+                cache_seqlens,

+        metadata.page_size = self.page_size

+    def _init_kpool_metadata(
+        self,
+        metadata: AscendDSAForwardMetadata,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+        real_page_table: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens_expanded: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Compute KPoolExtendPlan / KPoolWritePlan (NPU PyTorch variants).
+
+        Mirrors dsa_backend.py _init_kpool_metadata but uses NPU-safe
+        PyTorch implementations instead of CUDA Triton kernels.
+        """
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.kpool_plan import (
+            _alloc_kpool_write_plan_buffers,
+            init_kpool_extend_metadata_npu,
+            update_kpool_write_plan_npu,
+        )
+
+        pool_size = self.dsa_index_kpool
+        slots_per_page = self.page_size
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+
+        # ── Extend: build KPoolExtendPlan (writes + tails) ──
+        if forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative():
+            init_kpool_extend_metadata_npu(
+                metadata,
+                forward_batch,
+                pool_size=pool_size,
+                real_page_size=self.page_size,
+                slots_per_page=slots_per_page,
+                full_real_page_table=real_page_table,
+                local_seqlens_expanded=seq_lens_expanded,
+            )
+            return
+
+        # ── Verify / draft-extend-v2: build KPoolWritePlan ──
+        # Plain NPU decode updates the KPool cache directly through
+        # kpool_decode_update_index_cache and does not consume this plan.
+        if not (forward_mode.is_target_verify() or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()):
+            return
+
+        is_v2 = forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+        num_draft_tokens = self.speculative_num_draft_tokens
+
+        if num_draft_tokens == 0:
+            return
+
+        # Allocate the plan here for capture/eager execution; graph replay only
+        # refreshes these buffers in place.
+        plan = _alloc_kpool_write_plan_buffers(
+            max_bs=forward_batch.batch_size,
+            num_draft_tokens=num_draft_tokens,
+            kpool=pool_size,
+            device=forward_batch.seq_lens.device,
+            is_verify=True,
+            is_v2=is_v2,
+        )
+        metadata.kpool_write_plan = plan
+
+        # The two MTP stages use different seq_lens semantics, so recover the
+        # ring-write start for this iteration.
+        seq_lens = forward_batch.seq_lens[: forward_batch.batch_size]
+        if is_v2:
+            write_start = (seq_lens - self.speculative_num_draft_tokens).to(torch.int32)
+        else:
+            write_start = seq_lens.to(torch.int32)
+

+        # tokens for each request.
+        effective_n_per_batch = None
+        if is_v2 and forward_batch.spec_info is not None:
+            effective_n_per_batch = getattr(
+                forward_batch.spec_info, "num_accept_tokens", None
+            )
+            if effective_n_per_batch is not None:
+                effective_n_per_batch = effective_n_per_batch[
+                    : forward_batch.batch_size
+                ]
+

+        # implementation, preserving capture-time addresses.
+        update_kpool_write_plan_npu(
+            metadata,
+            write_start=write_start,
+            req_pool_indices=forward_batch.req_pool_indices[: forward_batch.batch_size],
+            real_page_table=real_page_table,
+            pool_size=pool_size,
+            real_page_size=self.page_size,
+            num_draft_tokens=num_draft_tokens,
+            forward_mode=forward_mode,
+            slots_per_page=slots_per_page,
+            effective_n_per_batch=effective_n_per_batch,

+    def _replay_dsa_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
+        """Update DSA metadata tensors in-place during graph replay."""
+        metadata = self.forward_metadata
+        assert isinstance(metadata, AscendDSAForwardMetadata)
+        forward_mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        bs = forward_batch.batch_size
+

+        if metadata.cache_seqlens_int32 is None or (
+            metadata.cache_seqlens_int32.shape != cache_seqlens.shape

+                "DSA graph replay cache_seqlens shape differs from capture: "
+                f"captured={getattr(metadata.cache_seqlens_int32, 'shape', None)}, "
+                f"replay={cache_seqlens.shape}, batch_size={bs}."

+            forward_batch.req_pool_indices[:bs], :max_seq_len_k
+        ]
+        new_real_page_table = (
+            (page_table_1[:, :: self.page_size] // self.page_size)
+            .to(torch.int32)
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+
+        n_rows, n_cols = new_real_page_table.shape
+        if (
+            metadata.real_page_table is None
+            or metadata.real_page_table.shape[0] != n_rows
+            or metadata.real_page_table.shape[1] < n_cols
+        ):

+                "DSA graph replay page-table shape exceeds capture buffer: "
+                f"captured={getattr(metadata.real_page_table, 'shape', None)}, "
+                f"replay={new_real_page_table.shape}, batch_size={bs}."
+            )

+        needs_causal_expansion = (
+            forward_mode.is_extend()
+            or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+        )
+        total_q, max_query_len = self._query_layout_sizes(forward_batch)
+        if needs_causal_expansion:
+            from sgl_kernel_npu.operators.indexer import expand_causal_seqlens
+
+            expected_shape = (total_q,)
+            if (
+                metadata.dsa_seqlens_expanded is None
+                or metadata.dsa_seqlens_expanded.shape != expected_shape
+                or metadata.token_to_batch_idx is None
+                or metadata.token_to_batch_idx.shape != expected_shape
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "DSA graph replay packed-query shape differs from capture: "
+                    "captured_seqlens="
+                    f"{getattr(metadata.dsa_seqlens_expanded, 'shape', None)}, "
+                    "captured_token_map="
+                    f"{getattr(metadata.token_to_batch_idx, 'shape', None)}, "
+                    f"replay={expected_shape}, batch_size={bs}."
+                )
+            expand_causal_seqlens(
+                cache_seqlens,
+                query_lens,
+                cache_seqlens.device,
+                total_q,
+                max_query_len,
+                seqlens_out=metadata.dsa_seqlens_expanded,
+                token_to_batch_out=metadata.token_to_batch_idx,
+            )
+        else:
+            expected_shape = (bs,)
+            if metadata.token_to_batch_idx is None or (
+                metadata.token_to_batch_idx.shape != expected_shape
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "DSA graph replay token-map shape differs from capture: "
+                    f"captured={getattr(metadata.token_to_batch_idx, 'shape', None)}, "
+                    f"replay={expected_shape}, batch_size={bs}."
+                )

+        # Plain decode has no plan because its index-cache update consumes the
+        # ForwardBatch and indexer metadata tensors directly.
+        if (
+            self.dsa_index_kpool > 1
+            and metadata.kpool_write_plan is not None
+            and (forward_mode.is_target_verify() or forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2())
+        ):
+            from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.kpool_plan import (
+                update_kpool_write_plan_npu,
+            )
+
+            is_v2 = forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
+            num_draft_tokens = self.speculative_num_draft_tokens
+            if num_draft_tokens > 0:
+                seq_lens = forward_batch.seq_lens[:bs]
+                if is_v2:
+                    write_start = (seq_lens - self.speculative_num_draft_tokens).to(
+                        torch.int32
+                    )
+                else:
+                    write_start = seq_lens.to(torch.int32)
+
+                # Draft v2 keeps a fixed-N graph shape but commits only the
+                # tokens accepted in this iteration.
+                effective_n_per_batch = None
+                if is_v2 and forward_batch.spec_info is not None:
+                    effective_n_per_batch = getattr(
+                        forward_batch.spec_info, "num_accept_tokens", None
+                    )
+                    if effective_n_per_batch is not None:
+                        effective_n_per_batch = effective_n_per_batch[
+                            : forward_batch.batch_size
+                        ]
+                update_kpool_write_plan_npu(
+                    metadata,
+                    write_start=write_start,
+                    req_pool_indices=forward_batch.req_pool_indices[:bs],
+                    real_page_table=metadata.real_page_table,
+                    pool_size=self.dsa_index_kpool,
+                    real_page_size=self.page_size,
+                    num_draft_tokens=num_draft_tokens,
+                    forward_mode=forward_mode,
+                    slots_per_page=self.page_size,
+                    effective_n_per_batch=effective_n_per_batch,
+                )

+        super().init_forward_metadata(forward_batch)

+def alltoall_buffer_kwargs(
+    buffer_cls,

+    enabled: bool,

+"""NPU-safe patch extraction for Transformers GLM5-Next processors.
+
+The generated Transformers GLM5-Next image and video processors materialize
+9- and 10-dimensional tensors in ``patchify``. Ascend's ``aclnnPermute`` supports
+at most 8 dimensions, so keep the upstream preprocessing flow and replace only
+that layout transformation.
+"""
+
+from functools import wraps
+
+import torch
+from sgl_kernel_npu.operators.multimodal import flatten_patches
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.modules.glm_vl_utils import (
+    _patch_processor_method,
+)
+
+
+def npu_wrapper_glm5_next_image_patchify(func):
+    @wraps(func)
+    def patchify(
+        self,
+        images: torch.Tensor,
+        patch_size: int,
+        merge_size: int,
+        temporal_patch_size: int,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int, int]:
+        flattened_patches, grid_t, grid_h, grid_w = flatten_patches(
+            images.unsqueeze(1),
+            patch_size=patch_size,
+            merge_size=merge_size,
+            temporal_patch_size=temporal_patch_size,
+        )
+        if grid_t != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"Expected one temporal image grid, got {grid_t}")
+        return flattened_patches, grid_h, grid_w
+
+    return patchify
+
+
+def npu_wrapper_glm5_next_video_patchify(func):
+    @wraps(func)
+    def patchify(
+        self,
+        videos: torch.Tensor,
+        patch_size: int,
+        merge_size: int,
+        temporal_patch_size: int,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int, int, int]:
+        return flatten_patches(
+            videos,
+            patch_size=patch_size,
+            merge_size=merge_size,
+            temporal_patch_size=temporal_patch_size,
+        )
+
+    return patchify
+
+
+_NPU_PATCH_MARKER = "_sglang_npu_safe_glm5_next_patchify"
+
+
+def npu_apply_glm5_next_preprocess_patch(processor) -> bool:
+    """Patch the concrete GLM5-Next processors held by ``processor``.
+
+    ``trust_remote_code`` loads classes below ``transformers_modules.*`` rather
+    than ``transformers.models.glm5_next.*``. Patching the instances' concrete
+    classes covers both layouts without depending on a generated module name.
+    Return True only when every present inner processor exposes ``patchify``.
+    """
+    patches = []
+    for kind, wrapper in (
+        ("image", npu_wrapper_glm5_next_image_patchify),
+        ("video", npu_wrapper_glm5_next_video_patchify),

+def _patch_processor_method(processor, method: str, wrapper, marker: str) -> bool:
+    """Patch the actual class, including remote classes; report supported APIs."""
+    processor_type = type(processor)
+    original = getattr(processor_type, method, None)
+    if not callable(original):
+        return False
